scope: art concept only; no runtime implementation or technical design revision

skyCandidate.identityReview: Target game, workspace and recorded SHA-256 match; candidate identified by atmosphere-only content.

composition.method: Reuse existing atmosphere-only raster. Sky and haze continuous, with only sparse far silhouettes.
Low-contrast code silhouettes arranged in the same world; no complete panorama input.
Code builds solid walls, columns and rails; existing raster eaves, roof crown, support blocks, stalls and lantern sprites give material detail. Every roof and lantern cable has a visible support.
Sparse near eaves/rails occlude the same assembled street; never ghost an entire duplicate layer.
Cool grey-blue distance, darker near masses, sparse warm lanterns; light affects the actual supporting walls.

longMap: Extend one assembled street with varied heights, spacing and density, keeping an open flight path; no chain of full-scene paintings.
